# Variable `LOCALE_PATHS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The LOCALE_PATHS variable holds a whitespace separated list of paths that are scanned to construct `-locale` packages during Package Splitting. The list contains `${datadir}/locale` by default.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-LOCALE_PATHS)
